questions.question: In which capital city is the iconic Eiffel Tower located?
questions.explanation: The Eiffel Tower is situated on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.

questions.question: Which ancient land is home to the Great Pyramids of Giza?
questions.explanation: The Great Pyramids are ancient architectural wonders situated in Egypt.

questions.question: Modern AI algorithms and robotics belong to which field?
questions.explanation: AI and robotics are driving forces in modern high technology innovation.
